# Giovanni Nicolazzo — research profile

- Primary profile page: https://colazeta.github.io/
- Person: Giovanni Nicolazzo (Ricercatore)
- Focus: infiltrazione criminale nell'economia legale, opacità di mercato, catene proprietarie, rischio sanzioni/AML, reti di intermediazione.
- Methods: network methods, ownership reconstruction, case-based research, risk indicator design.
- Public profiles:
  - https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=5zc-vxQAAAAJ
  - https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5551-2682
  - https://www.transcrime.it/en/people/giovanni-nicolazzo/
  - https://github.com/colazeta
- Selected publication links are available on the main profile page in the "Pubblicazioni selezionate" section.
